title: Score HEAR
formula:
To calculate the HEAR Score, add the points for each variable:

| Variable | Points | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| H istory | Slightly suspicious | 0 |
| Moderately suspicious | 1 | |
| Highly suspicious | 2 | |
| E lectrocardiogram | Normal | 0 |
| Nonspecific repolarization disturbance 1 | 1 | |
| Significant ST-deviation | 2 | |
| A ge | <45 years | 0 |
| 45-64 years | 1 | |
| ≥ 65 years | 2 | |
| R isk factors 2 | No known risk factors | 0 |
| 1 or 2 risk factors | 1 | |
| ≥3 risk factors 3 | 2 | |

1. Nonspecific repolarization disturbance, left bundle branch block, or pacemaker.
2. Risk factors for atherosclerotic disease: hypercholesterolemia, hypertension, diabetes mellitus, cigarette smoking, positive family history, obesity.
3. ≥3 risk factors or history of atherosclerotic disease.

how_to_use.why:
- Provides rapid bedside risk stratification using information generally available to estimate a patient’s 30-day risk of MACE.
- May help identify very low risk patients who are unlikely to benefit from cardiac biomarker testing.
how_to_use.when:
- À utiliser chez les patients adultes (≥ 18 ans) se présentant aux urgences avec une douleur thoracique non traumatique.
- Ne pas appliquer chez les patients présentant des modifications ischémiques évidentes à l'ECG, une instabilité hémodynamique, une douleur thoracique persistante ou réfractaire, un examen physique préoccupant, une coronaropathie connue (CAD) ou un diagnostic alternatif urgent évident.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Designed as a partial [HEART Score](nabda:calc.heart-score-major-cardiac-events) (as part of a 2-step HEART strategy), allowing clinicians to distinguish patients at very low risk of major adverse cardiac events (MACE) from those who should undergo the full [HEART Pathway](nabda:calc.heart-pathway-early-discharge-acute-chest-pain) .
- Highly sensitive for identifying very low risk patients (99% sensitivity), with a false-negative rate of 0.4% (1 of 279 patients) in the derivation study.
- The derivation study also suggested a potential 19% reduction in troponin testing with the use of this tool.

next_steps.advice: Atteindre le seuil « très faible risque » ne constitue pas un « risque nul » ; associez les résultats au jugement clinique et aux protocoles locaux.
next_steps.management:
- **Score ≤1** (with nonischemic ECG and no known CAD):

 - Suggests very low risk for MACE.
 - Troponin testing may be avoided, or single troponin testing may be appropriate (depending on local protocols).
 - Patients who are discharged should be provided clear return precautions.
- **Score ≥2** (or any concern for ACS): Proceed with [HEART Score](nabda:calc.heart-score-major-cardiac-events) / [HEART Pathway](nabda:calc.heart-pathway-early-discharge-acute-chest-pain) and standard ACS evaluation.

more_info:
Interprétation :

| <2 | Faible |
| ≥2 | Non faible |

medium_description: Stratifie le risque de NSTEMI et évalue la nécessité d’un dosage de la troponine.

instructions: Cet outil est similaire au [HEART Score](nabda:calc.heart-score-major-cardiac-events) et au [HEART Pathway](nabda:calc.heart-pathway-early-discharge-acute-chest-pain), mais n'inclut pas la troponine ; utilisez-le lorsqu'un patient est suspecté d'être à très faible risque de syndrome coronarien aigu (ACS).
